title: Vendor Price Submission
description: A product price offered to one customer tenant, by the vendor that sells it or by a member of that tenant, and accepted into that tenant's price book, where it supersedes the reference price for that tenant only. Tagged to the manufacturer and the specific product. A price taken from a price list cites that list as a document with its declared source; every price says what kind of price it is and where it came from. A price may name the part record its product is an instance of; it then applies to every occurrence of that part type, as IFC 4.3 rate-based costing applies the rate on an IfcTypeProduct (IfcCostScheduleTypeEnum SCHEDULEOFRATES). Every price states its stage.

vendorRef.description: The vendor offering the price, when the vendor submits it.

submittedBy.description: The party that entered the price into the tenant's price book -- the vendor, by its party URI, or a member of the tenant, by its record id. The price belongs to the tenant either way; this records who put it there.

bpcProduct.description: The product as the catalog keys it.

partRecordRef.description: The part record the product is an instance of, by its materialDefinitionId: an OpenMaterial part record's ISA-95 material definition identifier, an absolute IRI.

price.description: The price per one priceUom: a decimal string and its ISO 4217 currency.

priceUom.description: The unit the price is per, as a UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20 code.

amount.description: The price per one priceUom at or above minQuantity, in the price's currency.

region.description: The area the price applies in. Absent, the price applies nationally.

supersedes.description: The submissionId of the earlier price this one replaces, for the same tenant and product.

basis.description: Where the figure came from; a price copied from a published list is a default naming that list as its source.

provenance.description: Proof of where the price came from and that it is unchanged.

sourceDocument.description: The price list or quote the price was taken from, by reference and digest, its source declared in its provenance.

priceKind.description: The price's stage, from least to most committed: estimated (an estimate; IFC IfcCostValue.Category 'Estimated cost'), vendor-published (a listed price; UBL Catalogue / CataloguePricingUpdate; IFC 'List price'), quoted (an offer answering a request; UBL RequestForQuotation then Quotation; IFC IfcCostScheduleTypeEnum TENDER), contracted (an agreed price; UBL Order / OrderResponse; IFC 'Contract'), vendor-invoice (a price as charged; UBL Invoice / CreditNote; IFC 'Purchase').
